title: Deputy Fire Chief Realizes He Hit an 11-Year-Old Girl
description:
Bodycam footage shows the moments surrounding the drunk driving arrest of a deputy fire chief in Michigan who allegedly hit and injured an 11-year-old girl. Deputies took Michael Dyer into custody after he admitted to drinking "gin and tonics" and failed field sobriety tests, according to an arrest affidavit. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
